provenance_boundary: The exact V1 -5%/-3%/W3 negative result was known before this contract arrived. None of the 18 V1.1 cells uses that exact parameter point. This spec is frozen before opening any V1.1 cell outcome and makes no pristine-family preregistration claim.
scientific_question: Does downside shock followed by observable absorption or stabilization produce favorable future return across a coherent neighboring parameter region rather than at one lucky definition?

universe.source: exact causal daily feature panel frozen by ASHARE-MULTISCALE-DIFFUSION-DAILY-ALPHA-CYCLE-015
universe.eligibility: hard-valid, PIT-lineage-valid, corporate-action-valid, current tradable non-ST rows with 120 consecutive valid stock sessions, prior-20 average amount at least CNY 50 million, and at least six same-date PIT-industry peers
universe.industry: historical PIT industry; leave-one-out equal-weight eligible-peer log-return representation
universe.fail_closed: unknown lineage, invalid action coordinate, missing required consecutive session, or unresolved execution is unusable

parameter_grid.cell_id: ABS_m04|ABS_m06|ABS_m08 joined to REL_m02|REL_m04 and W2|W3|W5

event.qualification: stock causal simple return at s is at or below the cell absolute threshold AND stock simple return minus PIT-industry leave-one-out simple return is at or below the cell relative threshold
event.overlap: within each cell accept the first qualifying shock, suppress the same symbol through s+W, and permit a new event at s+W+1; suppression precedes observation-completeness inspection
event.observation: exactly the cell's W completed consecutive valid sessions s+1 through s+W
event.signal_known_at: after completed close s+W, decision_at 15:30 Asia/Shanghai
event.earliest_entry: first accepted buyable legal open strictly after s+W, scanning at most 20 market sessions

representations.stabilization: FURTHER_DRAWDOWN_RATIO_W=max(0,C(s)-min(C(s+1:s+W)))/ShockLoss; rank its negative so higher rank is stronger stabilization
representations.industry_relative_recovery: sum over s+1:s+W of stock causal step log return minus same-session PIT-industry leave-one-out mean log return; diagnostic only

ranking.assignment: within cell and signal-confirmation date using deterministic average percentile rank and ceil(5*pct_rank), clipped to Q1..Q5
ranking.small_dates: retain for coverage but exclude from Q1..Q5 economics

outcomes.cost: 20 bps per side embedded in net return
outcomes.absolute: accepted causal-coordinate return from legal entry open through each entry-relative close
outcomes.industry_relative: stock net outcome minus same cell, confirmation-date, initial-PIT-industry mean net outcome
outcomes.broad_relative: stock net outcome minus same cell and confirmation-date mean net outcome
outcomes.mae: minimum accepted causal-coordinate low from entry through h20 relative to entry cost

surface.adjacency: Manhattan distance one on ordered absolute-threshold, relative-threshold, and window axes
surface.adequate_cell_support: at least 200 complete Q1 and 200 complete Q5 outcomes at each of h5/h10/h20 and at least 60 distinct confirmation dates
surface.full_period_favorable_cell: adequate support; mean industry-relative Q5-Q1 across h5/h10/h20 >= +0.002; at least two of three industry-relative spreads positive; mean absolute Q5-Q1 across h5/h10/h20 > 0
surface.chronologically_coherent_cell: full-period favorable; early and late mean industry-relative h5/h10/h20 spread each > 0; at least four of six annual mean industry-relative h5/h10/h20 spreads > 0
surface.stable_region: a connected component of at least four chronologically coherent cells spanning at least two absolute thresholds, both relative thresholds, and at least two windows
surface.region_choice: largest cell count; ties prefer a component containing ABS_m06/REL_m04/W3; remaining ties use lexicographically sorted cell-id tuple
surface.region_center: cell minimizing total Manhattan distance to all component cells; ties minimize distance to ABS_m06/REL_m04/W3, then use fixed grid order
surface.isolated_optimum: at least one full-period favorable cell exists but the largest favorable connected component has at most two cells
surface.mixed_surface: no stable region and at least half of adequate cells reverse the sign of their mean h5/h10/h20 industry-relative spread between early and late blocks
surface.broad_null_or_adverse: at least 12 of 18 cells have nonpositive full-period mean h5/h10/h20 industry-relative spread

controls.shock_severity: within target, fixed absolute-loss bins [threshold,8%),[8%,10%),[10%,infinity) with the first empty when threshold is 8%, and relative-loss bins [threshold,6%),[6%,8%),[8%,infinity); supported at 20 Q1 and 20 Q5; at least half of supported cells must have positive mean h5/h10/h20 industry-relative ordering
controls.generic_recovery: for ABS_m06/REL_m04 separately at W2/W3/W5, one deterministic eligible negative-return nonshock match per complete shock: same date and PIT industry first, nearest causal stock return then symbol; same-date fallback; matched cell is generic only when its mean h5/h10/h20 industry-relative recovery spread is positive and at least 75% of the corresponding shock spread
controls.pre_shock_trend: causal prior-20 stock log return, fixed within-date terciles on target
controls.realized_volatility: causal prior-20 sample standard deviation, fixed within-date terciles on target
controls.liquidity: authoritative prior-20 average amount, fixed within-date terciles on target
controls.coarse_control_pass: for each control at least two of three terciles have positive mean h5/h10/h20 industry-relative Q5-Q1

requires: corresponding generic recovery is not similar
walk_forward_gate.if_fail: stop before walk-forward and Strategy-B replay

walk_forward_selection.training_rows: only observations whose h20 outcome date is at or before the selection cutoff
walk_forward_selection.training_favorable_cell: at least 100 complete Q1 and Q5 observations per h5/h10/h20 and 30 dates; mean industry-relative h5/h10/h20 Q5-Q1 >= +0.002; at least two horizons positive; mean absolute spread > 0
walk_forward_selection.training_region: connected component of at least four training-favorable cells spanning two absolute thresholds, both relative thresholds, and two windows
walk_forward_selection.region_choice: same largest-component, anchor-containment, lexicographic rule as full surface
walk_forward_selection.selected_cell: same deterministic Manhattan center rule as full surface; never maximum return
walk_forward_selection.application_rows: selected-cell signals in the application year with each reported horizon outcome completed no later than that year end
walk_forward_selection.aggregate: pool only the mechanically selected future-year cell observations across 2021-2023
walk_forward_selection.pass: a signal is selected in at least two of three years; aggregate industry-relative Q5-Q1 mean across h5/h10/h20 >= +0.002 with at least two horizons positive; no selected application year has mean h5/h10/h20 industry-relative Q5-Q1 <= -0.002; Manhattan distance between successive non-NO_SIGNAL selected cells is at most two

strategy_a_independence.target: region center when a region exists, otherwise fixed anchor
diagnostics: same-date rank correlation with exact signal-date Low-MAX

classification.priority: stable-region and gate result first; if gate passes, walk-forward decides promising stable versus weak/not-selectable; if no region, isolated then chronological then broad null/adverse

actionability.immediate: first session after confirmation has accepted buyable open
actionability.delayed: later accepted buyable open within 20 sessions

prohibited: Downside Resilience input, inversion, tuning, or rescue

intraday, VWAP, candlestick, volume composite, RSI, moving average, support, reclaim, gap, limit-down, industry-specific, market-cap-specific, hand-picked-year, sign-inversion, or machine-learning rescue
full-period best-return or best-Sharpe cell selection
Strategy-A modification, A+B combination, Champion replay, Strategy-B portfolio replay, Top-N, cutoff, holding, weight, exit, turnover, or capacity optimization
OOS, independent-confirmation, validation, live, or production claim
